Detailed Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, App Engine Studio, and custom applications.
•	Define scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures aligned with business and technical requirements.
•	Design and implement integrations using REST APIs with enterprise applications, ensuring secure authentication, error handling, and monitoring.
•	Architect workflow automation using Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, Service Catalog, Record Producers, and Order Guides.
•	Lead ServiceNow platform upgrades, release planning, risk assessment, deployment strategy, and post-upgrade validation.
•	Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) strategies to improve release quality, regression testing, and platform stability.
•	Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, governance, and enforcement of ServiceNow best practices.
•	Develop and oversee platform customizations including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Scheduled Jobs, Workspaces, and Database Views.
•	Manage platform security, CMDB governance, domain separation, data integrity, reporting, dashboards, and enterprise platform health.
•	Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, development teams, QA, and executive leadership to deliver AI-enabled ServiceNow solutions and provide strategic technical guidance.

Required Qualifications:
•	Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
•	ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification (mandatory).
•	ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications preferred.
•	ServiceNow Micro-Certifications in Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Virtual Agent, or App Engine are desirable.

Required Experience:
•	Approximately 10–12 years of experience implementing and architecting ServiceNow solutions within enterprise environments.
•	Extensive experience across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, Service Catalog, CMDB, App Engine Studio, Flow Designer, and platform customization.
•	Proven experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs and IntegrationHub.
•	Hands-on experience leading ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, domain-separated implementations, and enterprise migrations.
•	Experience implementing Automated Test Framework (ATF) and enterprise testing strategies.
•	Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders and leading discovery workshops, solution design, and technical governance.
•	Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within the ServiceNow ecosystem is highly desirable.

Required Skills and Competencies:
•	Expert knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture and solution design.
•	Strong expertise in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Service Portal/Workspaces.
•	Deep understanding of Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, CMDB, Discovery, and ServiceNow security architecture.
•	Experience designing scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise ServiceNow solutions.
•	Strong knowledge of REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, integration patterns, and automation frameworks.
•	Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills with the ability to engage CXO-level audiences.
•	Strong leadership, mentoring, architectural governance, and decision-making capabilities.
•	Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions while driving AI-first digital transformation initiatives.

About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role: 
We are seeking a skilled System Administrator with strong Linux and VMware expertise to support and maintain enterprise infrastructure within a data center environment in a Managed Services team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing Linux servers, VMware virtualization platforms, system performance, security, and operational stability while ensuring high availability of critical telecom and business systems.


Key Responsibilities
•	Install, configure, administer, and maintain Linux server environments (Red Hat, CentOS, Ubuntu, SUSE, or equivalent). 
•	Manage and support VMware vSphere, ESXi hosts, vCenter, virtual machines, and associated infrastructure components. 
•	Perform server provisioning, patch management, upgrades, and system hardening activities. 
•	Monitor infrastructure health, capacity, performance, and availability across physical and virtual environments in a telecom production environment. 
•	Troubleshoot Linux OS, VMware, storage, and networking issues impacting telecom services. 
•	Configure and maintain user accounts, permissions, authentication services, and security policies. 
•	Support backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity processes aligned with telecom SLAs. 
•	Implement and maintain system monitoring and automation tools used in managed services operations. 
•	Perform root cause analysis and proactively resolve infrastructure incidents within SLA timelines. 
•	Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and system configurations. 
•	Collaborate with network, storage, backup, security, and telecom operations teams. 
•	Participate in 24/7 on-call support and shift-based operations as required in managed services delivery. 
 
Required Experience
•	Minimum 3–5 years of experience as a Linux System Administrator, VMware Administrator, or Infrastructure Engineer. 
•	Strong hands-on experience in enterprise and telecom-grade environments. 
•	Proven experience managing VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, VM provisioning, clustering, and virtualization technologies. 
•	Experience with server performance tuning, monitoring, patching, and troubleshooting in production environments. 
•	Knowledge of storage technologies including SAN, NAS, and virtual storage environments. 
•	Experience supporting enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions. 
•	Familiarity with scripting and automation using Bash, Shell, Python, or Ansible. 

This role operates in a 24/7 managed services setup supporting large-scale telecom infrastructure, where stability, performance, and rapid incident resolution are critical.

Next Steps
If you would like to express interest in the role, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Salary: From $90,000 AUD per annum plus Superannuation

result.description: The Trustee for R & C UNIT TRUST   Leading Hand Formwork Carpenter     Reports to : Project Manager / Site Manager   Direct Reports:  Carpenters / Apprentice / Construction Labourers / Trade Assistants       Position Summary   The Leading Hand Formwork Carpenter is responsible for carrying out hands-on formwork carpentry works while providing day-to-day supervision and guidance to small site crews on major energy infrastructure projects. The role involves constructing, installing and dismantling formwork systems, interpreting engineering drawings, coordinating daily work activities and ensuring works are completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with project specifications, quality standards and Work Health and Safety requirements.   Key Duties and Responsibilities   •    Read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications and construction plans for formwork and reinforced concrete structures.   •    Measure, cut, assemble, erect and dismantle timber, plywood and engineered formwork for footings, slabs, columns, walls, beams and other concrete structures.   •    Construct, install and maintain formwork systems in accordance with project specifications, Australian Standards and quality requirements.   •    Inspect completed formwork to ensure correct dimensions, alignment, bracing and structural integrity prior to concrete placement.   •    Carry out repairs, modifications and adjustments to formwork and temporary structures as required throughout the construction process.   •    Operate and maintain hand tools, power tools and construction equipment safely and efficiently.   •    Supervise and provide day-to-day guidance to a small team of carpenters and labourers, allocating tasks and monitoring work progress to ensure quality workmanship and timely project delivery.   •    Coordinate daily formwork activities with engineers, site supervisors, steel fixers, concreters and other trades to support efficient project outcomes.   •    Monitor the quality of completed carpentry works and rectify defects where required to ensure compliance with project specifications.   •    Assist with planning material requirements and ensure the safe handling, storage and use of construction materials on site.   •    Maintain a clean, safe and organised work area by identifying and reporting hazards and ensuring compliance with Work Health and Safety (WHS) legislation, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and company policies.   •    Complete works within project timeframes while maintaining high standards of workmanship, safety and quality.   Skills, Experience and Qualifications   •    Certificate III in Carpentry (or equivalent overseas qualification), or a higher relevant qualification.   •    Demonstrated experience as a Formwork Carpenter.   •    Proven experience constructing, installing and dismantling formwork systems for reinforced concrete structures.   •    Experience supervising or leading small site crews and coordinating daily construction activities.   •    Sound ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, construction plans and technical specifications.   •    Strong knowledge of formwork systems, construction methods, Australian Standards and quality requirements.   •    Proficiency in the safe operation of hand tools, power tools and construction equipment.   •    Sound understanding of Work Health and Safety (WHS) legislation, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and safe work practices.   •    Strong communication, leadership, teamwork and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced construction environment.   •    Ability to work across multiple project locations, including FIFO/DIDO assignments, as required.   •    Current Construction Induction (White Card) and a valid driver's licence.  •    Additional industry licences or tickets (e.g. Working at Heights, Elevated Work Platform, Dogging, Rigging or First Aid) are advantageous.     About Company     About T&S Construct   T&S Construct is an Australian construction company specialising in formwork, concrete and structural construction services for major civil and energy infrastructure projects.
